details: This package is a controlled canary/test artifact that beacons host metadata when its module is required. package/backend-canary.js builds a request to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle and appends two query parameters: 'host' = sha256 of the contents of /etc/hostname and 'user' = sha256 of os.userInfo().username.
